name: House - Sangkuriang Dago
detail: I visit this part of Bandung several times a year for business. Before House - Sangkuriang opened, I stayed several times at the Scarlet Dago across the street, and before that opened, I had stayed at a few places on Dago proper or on Jalan Merdeka. Compared to the other places I've stayed at in Bandung -- all of which are in the same price range -- the rooms at House - Sangkuriang are smaller but in much better condition and much more comfortable. Hopefully it will stay that way. The staff at House - Sangkuriang may be the friendliest staff I've ever experienced in all my trips to Indonesia -- they really look out for your needs as a traveler, are there to offer suggestions on just about anything, and will offer you a complimentary coffee or tea or water any time you sit down in the lobby/lounge area. (And the coffee is good, brewed in European style -- better than Starbucks!) MY ONLY TWO COMPLAINTS are (1) that the rooms are not soundproofed from street noise, so loud motorbikes coming up the hill might keep you awake until almost midnight or wake you up after 6 am (although I've had this problem in other hotels in Bandung as well), and (2) the internet in the rooms was fast when it worked, but it was down part of the time and kicked you off every 20 minutes on the dot when it was working (the internet in the lobby was better and didn't kick you off).

name: Aryaduta Bandung
detail: I stayed in this hotel during my business trip in Bandung and had a 2 days meeting which has to be relocated in the last minutes. Surprisingly the hotel staff offered me the meeting room. They arranged everything perfectly, professionally and made my meetings went smoothly. Many thanks for all the staff who made this possible. Another thing I noticed is they are striving to make their client satisfied and this is something that I never found in other 5 stars hotels in Bandung. Definitely will stay in this hotel again, as always =)

name: Hotel Mercure Bandung City Centre
detail: Mercure Bandung City Centre is a new and hip place to stay in. It wasn't too expensive but I don't consider it very cheap either. But since it is new, I didn't mind paying the amount that I did. The decor of the hotel is modern and very pleasant. The room was quite spacious, and the bed very comfortable. I also spent considerable time at the pool, which was not very big but sufficient to do some laps. The deck chairs did not have cushions so they tend to get a little hot under the sun but you could get a towel and use that to lay on. When it got too hot, the couch and chairs in the shade were very comfortable. I most enjoyed the service provided by the staff, who were always friendly and helpful! And I'm not only talking about people at the front desk. The servers in the restaurant were awesome, so were the guys at the pool, and the housekeeping staff! However, because it is a new hotel, it has the expected teething problems. The most jarring problem that stood out to me was the breakfast in the hotel cafe. For 4 mornings, I only enjoyed the congee and the egg station, because they were the only hot food available (there was also soto in a boiling pot but I did not eat that). The other food, like the fried noodles, fried rice, vegetables etc that were in food warmers were cold because the heaters were not turned on. That defeats the purpose of putting the food in the warmers... I had dinner in the restaurant at the first night as well and the food took a very long time to come as well. But the staff were so nice that I didn't mind the wait too much. Continue to improve, Mercure Bandung City Centre! I might come back again.

name: InterContinental Bandung Dago Pakar By IHG
detail: We decided to stay at Interncontinental Bandung, as we want to stay in Five star hotel with gorgeous scenery view and fresh air. There are plenty of hotel close to nature and mountain view (Lembang area), but none of the hotel meet International five star standard. There are plenty of five star hotel in Bandung, but none of them, have beautiful view and modern design, with five star services (most of the hotel located in the city). Only Intercontinental Bandung offer both views and comfort with five star level of service. The food is great, we are having great barbeque buffet, but most impressive is, when we arrive, we got room upgrade, and the room was ready (the air con is already on)., which barely happen in other five star hotel. (usually check in time 3pm, and the room is not air con ready yet). The infinity pool overlooking green lush view of Bandung is fantastic! Luxurious room (and bathroom design) I love it so much. I love the hotel design, the interior.

name: Sensa Hotel Bandung
detail: This is by far one of the best hotels in Bandung. Not a high class hotel, but not shabby either. If u r looking for clean n comfort, sensa has it all. The room is quite spacious, enough for u to even put yr luggage bag. Each rm has a balcony, the view is not really spectacular but Acceptable. We didhave a problem with our balcony door, jus needed to inf the front desk n they will send a guy up to yr rm to open rhe balcony door with a key. Toilet is quite spacious too, equipped with ecowasher toilet (my fav part of the toilet) and a standing shower. There is a huge full length mirror in the toilet which i personally liked. There is no door to separate the shower n toilet seat, jus a glass which actually causes water to splash out while bathing. But that is jus tolerable. The toilet door has no lock, jus slides close n open. But for me i'm ok with it as me n my husband can have our private toilet time but not too much. Bed was super huge enuff for me n my husband who are quite big sized. Tv channels are variety, if not for the shopping i could have just stayed indoors n watch cable. Breakfast buffet was fantastic. Even tho not as much spread as the one in bintan lagoon, however i was satisfied. Quite a variety of food, ranging frm light breakfast meals to heavy meals like rice n even the famous Bandung Bakso. The diner also has a nice view beside the swimming pool n a deck where pple can jus sit n chill. Staff are friendly n helpful. Room service was very fast. When i called room service saying i want an extra towel, the guy came up like in less than 5 mins. There was wifi in every floor, jus need to get a daily login id n password from the front desk. Location is also one of the best. The hotel is located next to Cihampelas Mall where u can find a lot of food, stores n supermarket. It is also located next to jeans street where u can find nice jeans. Do chk this plce out in google. Overall, i loved my stay.

name: de Braga, ARTOTEL Curated
detail: I had five nights in this hotel. This hotel is one of newest hotel in bandung. The location is near from train station and braga street. When I go to tourist attractions, it is very nice place for saving time. Breakfast is not bad. When I consider the price itself, it is best choice.
